event.title: Formula 1 Plans Grand Prix in Rwanda for Early 2030s
event.canonical_title: Formula 1 Plans Grand Prix in Rwanda for Early 2030s
event.summary: Formula One has announced its return to Africa with a Grand Prix scheduled to take place in Rwanda in the early 2030s. This marks the first Formula 1 race on the continent since 1993, highlighting Rwanda's ongoing investment in international sports.

key_facts: Formula One last hosted a race in Africa in 1993.
A new track in Rwanda will host the Grand Prix.

timeline.title: Rwanda to Host Africa's First Formula One Grand Prix Since 1993
timeline.summary: Formula One has announced that Rwanda will host Africa's first Grand Prix since 1993 in the early 2030s. This marks a significant return of the racing series to the continent after a long absence. The deal aims to enhance Rwanda's image and attract investment through sports.
key_facts: Rwanda will host Africa's first Formula One Grand Prix since 1993.
The event is scheduled for the early 2030s.
The deal is part of Rwanda's strategy to enhance its image and attract investment.
